entities.summary: Independence and Early Democracy, a transformative movement in Myanmar (1945–1962). Emerged from Battle of Imphal and Kohima — turning point of the Burma Campaign and Japanese Occupation and Resistance. Catalyzed Aung San and six cabinet members assassinated and Burma achieves independence from Britain.
